test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Constrict
solution: The correct answer is '**Stretch**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Constrict**' is '**Stretch**'. • **Constrict**: to become or make something tighter, narrower or less. (संकुचित होना या करना; सिकुड़ना, कसना) • *Example: She felt her throat **constrict** with fear.* • **Stretch**: to pull something so that it becomes longer or wider; to become longer or wider in this way. (किसी वस्‍तु को अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा करने के लिए खींचना; (किसी वस्‍तु का) खिंच कर अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा हो जाना, बढ़ जाना, तनन) • *Example: The artist **stretched** the canvas tightly over the frame.* **Correct Answer:__** *Stretch.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Smite**: strike with a firm blow. (जोरदार प्रहार) • **Choke**: to be or to make somebody unable to breathe because something is stopping air from getting into the lungs. (दम घुटना या घोटना) • **Cramp**: a sudden pain that you get in a muscle, that makes it difficult to move. (मांसपेशी में अचानक हुई दर्दभरी ऐंठन) 181:Tb37, The correct option is: **Since being set up**.
